abstract.label: Description
abstract.value: Initial target identities from ATOM-derived sequences and public sequence/PDB evidence.

detail.label: Note
detail.value: Artifacts: experiments/target_id/*.fasta and experiments/target_id/structure_summary.json. Target1 chain J residues 171-321 match human Mcl-1 BH3-binding domain/PDB 4HW2. Target2 chain A residues 580-867 match human TYK2 JH2 pseudokinase/PDB 7K7O or 4WOV family. Target3 chain R length 292 is a 7TM class A GPCR-like receptor with FDRY and NPxxY-region motifs; exact identity remains open. Decision: use Mcl-1 ligand evidence for result1, TYK2 JH2 allosteric evidence for result2, continue target3 identification before final selection.

abstract.label: Description
abstract.value: RCSB/PubChem-derived ligand families mapped to the identified targets.

detail.label: Note
detail.value: Target1 MCL1: RCSB 4HW2 contains inhibitor 19H, an acidic indole-2-carboxylic acid with chlorinated aryl hydrophobe for the BH3-binding groove. Target2 TYK2 JH2: RCSB 7K7O contains VZJ/compound-12 and 4WOV contains BMS-066/3SM, both pseudokinase-domain allosteric inhibitor families. Target3 GPR119: RCSB exact sequence hits identify glucose-dependent insulinotropic receptor/GPR119 with agonist complexes APD668/I7J, MBX-2982/8VP, GSK-1292263/A1D8Y, AR231453/8WL, plus allosteric DR7. Descriptor/SMILES evidence saved under experiments/public_evidence/rcsb_components and rcsb_entry_summary.json.

abstract.label: Description
abstract.value: Evaluated evidence-backed panel with local RDKit route checks and tier-1 proxy scoring.

detail.label: Note
detail.value: Panel artifact: experiments/candidates/panel.zip and panel_metadata.json. Probe baseline tier1 reproduced thresholds: result1 65.1588, result2 65.9992, result3 66.4825. One-step precursor routes improved route availability proxy over atom-inventory baseline while preserving final-product equality. Rejected: MCL1 benzothiophene acid had highest tier1 proxy but weak MCL1-specific groove evidence and poor tier2 affinity (-5.633); TYK2 VZJ route had elemental coverage issue in handcrafted SNAr route; probe-like set was valid but lower tier2 mean than co-crystal-heavy mix. Final direction selected co-crystal-heavy evidence: MCL1 4HW2/19H, TYK2 4WOV/3SM, GPR119 8ZRK/A1D8Y.
